Comments describe the mechanism (e.g. the contours.py comment now states the COCOS sign dependence in words rather than a stray if/else).
justifications.goal_fidelity: read at the reviewed head 54e491b and reproduced here in a scratch extraction under $TMPDIR (module.__file__ = /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261006T171549762429-review-of-ink-lint-sweep/ink-review-lint/head/imas_ink/__init__.py): plan section 2's done-when is met in full. ruff check imas_ink tests exits 0 at the head and the whole suite reports 418 passed, 6 skipped at both base and head with no failure and no error. No new module, view, abstraction or dependency is introduced, and the change removes code (the diff is +103/-93 across three commits, dominated by the sorted __all__ and the unchanged-behaviour rewrites).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 1564fc72..54e491b lists exactly the 20 paths the reviewed manifest declares as changed_paths, and only those: the 19 ruff-flagged source/test files plus docs/evidence/fragments/imas-ink-suite-green/ink-lint-sweep.html.
